svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Languages: Python (primary), TypeScript, C++, C, SQL, JavaScript, HTML and CSS. AI and agents: LangGraph, RAG, multi-agent systems, embeddings, vector search, NLP, Gemini. Backend and APIs: FastAPI, Node.js, Express, REST APIs, BullMQ, WebSockets. Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, pgvector, Prisma, Pandas, distributed locks. Cloud and delivery: Docker, AWS EC2, Git, cron, Vercel, OAuth 2.0, JWT. Fundamentals: DSA in C++, OOPS, operating systems, DBMS, unit testing with Vitest.
